question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is** "Surrugocy."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is **"Surrogacy."** • The incorrect option,** "Surrugocy", has "u" instead of "o" and "o" instead of "a."** • **"Surrogacy"** means the action or state of being a surrogate. (सरोगेट होने की क्रिया या अवस्था) • **Example**: ***Surrogacy**__ is frequently denounced as exploitation.* • The correct answer is Option 3. __ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__ • **Option 1: "Obdurate"** means stubborn or unyielding. (लोगों की इच्छानुसार अपना विचार बदलने से मना करना; हठधर्मी, ज़िद्दी) • **Option 2: "Cryptic"** means mysterious or puzzling. (गुप्‍त अर्थ वाला; रहस्‍यमय) • **Option 4: "Drastic"** means extreme or severe. (अत्‍यधिक और भरपूर असरदार, उग्र, प्रचंड) 39:T5c4, The correct answer is **"RQPS."**
